test_title: PYST 8: SSC CPO - Reasoning (Held on: 10 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are numbered from 1 to 6. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the one showing '3'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/450adb131409528da6171e2dd2ff403d9a7fc66fb04e5d1b9953e9c31beec7a9.png]
solution:
**Explanation:**

When we compare both the figures we get:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/79ec6e09485056c8b6fd21cbe3a9c4e0688afeb8895990a677d1bb4b587b1243.png] 

We observe that, when we move the dice downwards such that 5 and 6 are visible we find that on the bottom we have 4 and on the top we have 3 which means they both are opposite to each other. So **4** is the number on the face opposite the face showing 3.

**Hence, the correct answer is option 2.**
